chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, from more than one person, from Aban, from some of his companions, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The grave of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم is covered with red pebbles.

key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.قَبْرُ: grave; the burial place being described

ai.seo_question: How is the grave of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم described in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a physical description of the grave of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. It preserves a transmitted detail connected to the Prophet’s burial place and reflects early remembrance of his grave’s appearance.
